title: Final thoughts and thanks to Hinton
summary: Francis says the interview was a pleasure and recalls telling Hinton he would retire at his age yet still feels he is learning.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Hey man, this is beautiful. I wanted to know, do you have some kind of final statement or anything you'd like to say just to wrap this up, because it's been a really beautiful interview, and I sure thank you for it. I'm sure sometime in the future, people will be listening to this and very much appreciating what you have said, and will be very interested to know what times were like in our day, and what we went through and how we got where we are. So just to wind up, anything you'd like to say.

Well, all I can say is that this really was a pleasure for me to backtrack and go over all the things that happened during my life as a musician, and being able to talk about some of the wonderful people that I met, and how grateful I am to a lot of them -- you, for one. I remember one time we were in Cab's band together,

and you were a little older than I was -- or am --and we had some words, and I said to you, that when I get your age, I wouldn't even be playing drums, I would be retired. And here, when I got to be the age that you were at that time, I think I came to you and I told you, I reminded you of it, and I was able to say 'Well, man, I'm still playing,' and I was just really beginning to learn how to play the drums.
I think at the time you were something like 38, and when I got to be 38, that's when I realized that I didn't know what I was doing -- I was just learning.

And all of these things; I sit back and I think about them, and all I can say it that it has been a great education for me. I learned a lot, and I hope that my life in some way will help some young fellow to come up and do as well as I did or better.

Thank you, Panama. I'm sure they will, because just this interview, with just them listening to what you've accomplished and knowing that your life is still going on and is still going to greater heights, I'm sure it's going to be very advantageous.
